The '''Werncin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Werncin 3]] and the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Werncin 3|Werncin]].
